title: SC seeks 16% MRP cap on medicines, flags huge cancer drug markups
ai_summary: The Supreme Court of India has proposed a 16% cap on maximum retail prices of medicines, criticizing high markups on cancer drugs.

title: Sun Pharma plans $1 billion local debt sale for loan takeout
ai_summary: Sun Pharma aims to raise $1 billion via local debt to refinance a bridge loan taken for its acquisition of Organon's business.

title: Cholesterol calculus: Can the new generation drugs curb India's CVD burden?
ai_summary: New-generation lipoprotein-lowering therapies are being evaluated for their potential to reduce India's growing cardiovascular disease burden.
